description.en: Layered CSS perspective spins a wordmark through 3D space.

description.en: A six-faced CSS cube tumbling on a custom easing loop.
description.uz: Maxsus easing tsiklida aylanuvchi olti yoqli CSS kub.

description.en: Thousands of points forming a navigable particle grid.
description.uz: Minglab nuqtalardan tashkil topgan boshqariladigan zarracha to'ri.

description.en: A slow camera orbit around a procedural tech artifact.
description.uz: Protsedural texno-artefakt atrofida sekin kamera aylanishi.
